items.description:
Alessa Trading cc. is a hardware distributor based on Zambezi Drive in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, supplying a wide range of hardware items alongside decorative steel products and catering equipment. Its hardware range covers security locks, pad bolts, gate wheel sets, lugs, flange rivets and wall spikes, together with hinges in several styles including heavy-duty, bullet and butt hinges. The business also stocks welding rods and abrasives such as cutting and grinding discs, flap discs and velcro sandpaper.

Beyond hardware, Alessa Trading supplies decorative steel castings including spears, rosettes, pickets and panels, as well as mild steel products such as scrolls, onions, pressed leaf designs, decorative panels and round panels. For the catering trade it offers grids, pipe burners and gas valves, and it rounds out its catalogue with aluminium furniture ranging from tables to chairs and benches. Being based in Kameeldrift East places the business within reach of both household and trade buyers across Pretoria's northern suburbs who need hardware, decorative metalwork or catering equipment from a single supplier.

Alstodt Management Consulting is a business management consulting firm based in The Reeds, Centurion, offering strategic planning, process improvement and growth advisory services. The firm positions itself around scalable solutions designed to help businesses streamline their operations and work toward measurable results, rather than offering fixed, identical advice to every client. Its team works directly with clients to tailor strategic planning and process-improvement initiatives to the specific needs of each operation, with growth initiatives forming part of its advisory offering.

The practice operates from premises in The Reeds with wheelchair-accessible parking available on site. Operating from Centurion gives Alstodt Management Consulting convenient reach into the surrounding Centurion and greater Pretoria business community, where small and medium enterprises often need outside guidance on strategy and operational efficiency. By focusing on strategic planning, process improvements and growth-oriented advisory work, the consultancy aims to support businesses through the practical, day-to-day decisions involved in running and scaling an operation, rather than limiting its involvement to one-off projects or isolated recommendations.

Aperture Digital Media is a digital marketing agency based in Clubview, Centurion, that blends strategy, storytelling and search engine optimisation to help Pretoria businesses attract more website traffic and generate qualified leads. The agency's core offering is digital marketing, covering search engine optimisation, pay-per-click advertising, content creation, social media management and email marketing, with services designed to adapt as the digital landscape changes. Alongside marketing, Aperture Digital Media provides videography and photography services built around visual storytelling, capturing moments and crafting narratives for client brands. It also offers website design, building user-friendly digital experiences intended to blend form and function so visitors can be engaged and informed.

The agency describes its approach as holistic, aiming to cover every stage of a client's online presence from first contact through to conversion. Based in Clubview, the business serves both start-ups establishing an online presence for the first time and more established companies seeking to scale their digital marketing activity across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area.

APL Protect is a Valhalla-based importer of nanotechnology protective products, working with a number of Germany's product inventors to bring advanced coating technologies to the South African market. The company has partnered with CRYSTALTECH NANO to distribute a range of nanotechnology-based products, taking developments in nanotechnology and incorporating them into everyday protective coatings. APL Protect's offering is organised around Liquid Glass and SiO2-based science, with applications marketed across the automotive and marine industries as well as aerospace, through its association with Frasers Aerospace, and solar applications through its solar distributor channel.

The company states that its selected manufacturers operate their own research and manufacturing facilities, and it positions its product range as being backed by research and testing before reaching the local market. A product brochure is available on request for customers wanting more detail on the specific coatings offered. Operating from Valhalla, Pretoria, APL Protect serves as a local distribution point for these imported nanotechnology coating products across the automotive, marine, aerospace and solar sectors.

ARKE Creative Solutions is an office supplies business operating from the N4 Gateway Industrial Park in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, supplying consumables used by offices on a day-to-day basis. Its bathroom range includes toilet paper, bin liners, toilet blocks, paper towel rolls and air freshener, while its office consumables cover items such as brown and white sugar and coffee creamer in a range of pack sizes. The business also supplies cleaning and chemical products, including all-purpose cream cleaner, dishcloths, dustpan sets and cleaning gloves, alongside toiletries, masks and branded apparel.

ARKE Creative Solutions offers free delivery within Pretoria on orders over R500, making it a practical option for offices needing regular consumable top-ups without having to source multiple suppliers themselves. Based in the N4 Gateway Industrial Park, the business is positioned to serve offices across Pretoria's eastern and northern suburbs with bulk and repeat orders of the bathroom, kitchen and cleaning supplies that workplaces use continuously, rather than specialising in once-off purchases.

Ash Accounting & Management Services CC is an accounting, tax and bookkeeping firm based in Laudium, Centurion, established in 1995 and operating in the accounting environment for close to three decades. The firm prepares full sets of management accounts on a regular monthly basis, drawing on source documents such as customer invoices, supplier invoices and bank statements. Its services are grouped under accounting, taxation, and consulting and advisory, with a specific focus on corporate taxation given how significantly tax strategy can affect a business's overall position.

Ash Accounting works with clients across the country, with particular attention to the Laudium community in which it was established, aiming to improve the financial outlook and performance of the businesses it serves. The firm describes itself as service-driven, built around a single point of contact backed by a team of accounting professionals, and says it aims to contribute to the development of young professionals entering the accounting field. Based in Laudium, it provides accounting, tax and advisory support to businesses across Centurion and the greater Pretoria region.

ATW Construction (Pty) Ltd is a building and maintenance contractor based in Moregloed, Pretoria, established in 2007 and specialising in both commercial and domestic construction and plumbing work. The company positions itself around hands-on management and professionalism, covering construction, plumbing, electrical and general maintenance services for projects of varying scale.

Its construction team handles the building and assembly of infrastructure, while its plumbing and electrical services extend to installation work such as stormwater systems, diesel lines and galvanised supply lines. ATW Construction says it works through strategic associations with other established players in the construction industry, which it uses to keep pace with current industry developments and practices while giving clients access to a broader range of services than a single contractor might otherwise provide. Based in Moregloed, the company serves clients across Pretoria on both new-build and maintenance projects, applying its construction, plumbing and electrical capabilities to residential and commercial sites where several trades need to be coordinated under one contractor.

AUSENSIS is a digital agency operating from Southdowns Ridge Office Park in Irene, Centurion, built around a trio of core services: web development, app development and hosting solutions. The agency describes its approach as taking concepts from research through to launch, moving through stages of data analysis and market exploration, agile development with ongoing stakeholder feedback, automated regression testing and real-world simulation, before a final launch stage involving planning and coordinated marketing.

AUSENSIS says it has more than nine years of experience providing these digital agency services, working with clients who are looking to establish or transform an online presence, amplify a brand, or scale an existing digital product. Its combined focus on development and hosting means clients can have a website or application built and then kept running through the same provider, rather than coordinating separate developers and hosts. Operating from Centurion, AUSENSIS is positioned to serve businesses across Pretoria and the surrounding region that need web or app development paired with ongoing hosting support.

AutoConnect is a parts-funding company based in Monavoni, Centurion, that works with panel beaters and automotive repair shops to manage the cash flow involved in sourcing parts, consumables and outwork. The business handles parts procurement directly from suppliers on behalf of repair shops, aiming to eliminate delays and ensure parts arrive on time, while its funding model covers parts procurement for insurance claims without additional charges for back-ordered items. AutoConnect says it supports more than 94 insurers, over 300 OEM suppliers and more than 200 alternative part suppliers through its network, positioning itself as an intermediary that takes on the financial and logistical side of parts sourcing so repair shops can focus on vehicle repairs rather than chasing payments or stock. By managing funding and procurement together, the company aims to improve cash flow and productivity for the repair shops it works with, in turn supporting faster turnaround for their own customers and insurers.

Based in Monavoni, AutoConnect serves the automotive repair and panel-beating industry across the region.

AutoZone Gezina is an auto parts store operating from Shop 5 in Motor City on Steve Biko Road, Gezina, supplying a range of auto parts and related services to customers in the surrounding area. The store's Motor City location gives customers from nearby suburbs convenient access, whether they need a straightforward replacement part or a more complex component for a repair.

AutoZone Gezina operates on weekdays from 7:30am to 5pm and on Saturday mornings from 8am to 1pm, remaining closed on Sundays, a schedule that fits around standard workshop and repair-shop hours. Being based inside a dedicated motor city development places AutoZone Gezina alongside other automotive-related businesses, which can be convenient for customers running several car-related errands in one visit. The store caters to both simple and more complex automotive parts needs, positioning itself as a stop for Gezina-area motorists and workshops needing auto parts and related services without having to travel further into central Pretoria.

Avidan Consulting is a marketing consultancy based in Wierda Park, Centurion, focused on helping businesses take their products to market through a mix of innovative technology and more traditional marketing strategies. The consultancy positions effective marketing as something built on strong client relationships, and says it aims to offer clients exceptional service along with innovative problem-solving rather than a fixed, identical package for every client. Its approach spans both newer digital or technology-driven routes to market and conventional marketing methods, allowing it to tailor the mix of channels to what suits a particular product or client best. By combining these two strands, Avidan Consulting aims to give businesses more than one pathway for reaching customers, rather than relying solely on either digital tools or traditional advertising and promotion.

Based in Centurion, the consultancy serves clients across the greater Pretoria area who are looking to bring products to market and need support translating a product idea into an effective, relationship-driven market-entry strategy.

B-Link Consultants (Pty) Ltd is a Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) consulting firm based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, assisting companies with the scorecards and strategies needed to operate within South Africa's empowerment framework. The firm describes itself as a dedicated team of consultants with extensive experience in both consulting and the verification side of B-BBEE compliance, and says its consultants travel to clients rather than being limited to major cities.

Its services include B-BBEE consulting and preliminary level predictions, strategic scorecard planning aimed at optimum score building, and strategic ownership scheme implementation. B-Link Consultants also offers skills development, enterprise development, supplier development and socio-economic development solutions, covering the main pillars that make up a company's overall B-BBEE scorecard. By combining scorecard strategy with support across these individual elements, the firm positions itself to help businesses of varying sizes work through the legislation and build their rating over time, rather than addressing scorecard elements in isolation. Operating from Eldoraigne, it serves clients across Centurion, Pretoria and further afield given its stated willingness to travel.

Battery Pro Mobile is a mobile battery service operating out of Elardus Park, offering call-out battery installation and replacement for customers unable to get their vehicle started. Rather than requiring customers to bring their car in, the business sends someone out to the customer's home or roadside location to fit a replacement battery on the spot, with customers describing call-outs being completed in well under half an hour from first contact.

Alongside battery replacement, the business buys scrap batteries and handles vehicle licence disc renewals, giving it a second line of work beyond emergency call-outs. Feedback from customers in the Elardus Park area describes the service responding outside normal business hours, including late-evening enquiries answered with an early-morning replacement the next day, and roadside assistance provided directly on the street rather than only at a fixed workshop. Operating as a mobile service rather than from a single storefront, Battery Pro Mobile is positioned to reach stranded motorists across Elardus Park and the surrounding Pretoria area quickly, combining emergency battery replacement with scrap buying and licence renewal services.

Bbettr Agency is a performance marketing agency based in Centurion Golf Estate that builds websites and runs advertising campaigns intended to generate a steady stream of leads for client businesses. Its core services include website design and development focused on fast, conversion-oriented sites, together with Google Ads campaigns aimed at reaching people actively searching for what a client offers. The agency also runs Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns targeted at specific audiences to generate ongoing monthly enquiries, and it builds lead-generation systems intended to attract, capture and nurture leads so a client's sales pipeline stays full.

Alongside these services, Bbettr Agency offers automation and CRM systems, setting up workflows that follow up with leads automatically so a business can keep responding to enquiries outside normal working hours. The agency says it has worked with businesses across a range of industries in South Africa. Based in Centurion, Bbettr Agency serves South African businesses looking to combine website development, paid advertising and automated follow-up into a single ongoing marketing system.

Ben's Self Storage is a self-storage facility on Borage Avenue in Annlin, Pretoria North, offering a small range of lockable storage units aimed at households and individuals who need extra space. Each unit is individually lockable, and the premises itself is secured with perimeter electrical fencing, round-the-clock security and CCTV cameras covering the site. The facility offers small units of around nine square metres priced at R850 a month, medium units of around eighteen square metres at R1,100 a month, and standard-sized carports at R750 a month, all located on ground level for easy access.

Ben's Self Storage describes its approach to business as no-fuss and flexible, with a focus on a straightforward customer experience rather than long lock-in contracts or complicated terms. Positioned in Annlin, the facility serves households across Pretoria North, including the Montana, Sinoville, Doornpoort, Onderstepoort, Wonderboom and Magalieskruin areas, giving residents in these northern suburbs a nearby option for overflow storage, moving house or keeping seasonal items out of the way.

BluePrint Laundry Services operates a branch in Waverley Square on Hawthorne Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, as part of a laundry group offering services to households, hotels, hospitals and industrial clients across South Africa. The group's personal laundry service covers everyday washing, drying and folding for individuals and families, while its hotel laundry service supplies fresh linen, towels and bedding support for hotels and guesthouses. For healthcare clients, BluePrint Laundry Services provides hospital laundry care aimed at hospitals and clinics, and its industrial laundry service handles bulk washing of uniforms and workwear for industrial clients. The group also takes on commercial contracts for businesses needing ongoing laundry support, and offers bulk laundry services for customers with high-volume requirements.

BluePrint Laundry Services operates multiple branches across the country, including locations in Mbombela, Bloemfontein, Cape Town, Vereeniging and Centurion, alongside its Waverley branch in Pretoria. Through this branch network, the Waverley location gives Pretoria-based households and businesses access to the same personal, hotel, hospital, industrial and bulk laundry services offered across the wider group.

BODYTEC Erasmuskloof is a gym studio operating inside Castle Walk Shopping Centre on Nossob Street in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, forming part of a wider BODYTEC franchise with other branches across the Pretoria and Centurion area. The studio keeps varied hours across the week, opening earliest on Wednesday mornings from 5am and running as late as 8pm on weekdays, with shorter Friday and Saturday hours ending at 6pm and 2pm respectively.

As a gym-category studio, BODYTEC Erasmuskloof sits alongside sister branches in Brooklyn, Queenswood, Centurion and Eldoraigne, giving the brand a presence across several parts of the greater Pretoria area. Feedback left by clients describes the appeal of the format as time-efficient, pairing a busy lifestyle with intense workouts rather than longer conventional gym sessions, with clients reporting visible results in areas such as the glutes, thighs and arms after consistent weekly sessions. Based in Erasmuskloof, the studio is positioned for clients in the surrounding suburbs who want a structured, time-efficient workout format close to home rather than a full-scale conventional gym.

Bootlegger Irene Link is a Bootlegger Coffee Company outlet operating inside Irene Link Shopping Centre on Alexandra Road in Doringkloof, Centurion, serving specialty-grade coffee alongside all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch. The store is open seven days a week, with weekday and Saturday hours running from 6:30am to 6pm and Sunday hours from 6:30am to 5pm, giving customers a consistent all-day option through the week and over weekends. In keeping with the wider Bootlegger brand, the outlet positions its coffee as made consistently and sustainably, alongside a food menu built around all-day dining rather than breakfast or lunch service only.

Free wifi is available in-store, along with a dedicated kids menu and takeaway options for customers wanting to eat on the go. The branch also sits within a network of nearby Bootlegger locations around Centurion and Midrand, reflecting the brand's wider footprint in the area. Based in Doringkloof, Bootlegger Irene Link serves shoppers and residents around Irene Link Shopping Centre looking for a full-day coffee and casual dining option.

Booyens Law is an attorney firm based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, with more than 25 years of experience assisting individuals and corporate clients in securing compensation or legal relief. The firm's core practice areas include motor vehicle accident and personal injury claims, high court civil litigation, administration of deceased estates, and commercial law matters.

Booyens Law also assists clients with drafting wills and the supporting documentation needed to protect a person's interests and those of their family after death. The firm points to its handling of complex matters such as estate accrual disputes and large-scale class action litigation as part of its litigation experience, reflecting work that goes beyond routine claims into more involved high court matters. By combining personal injury and accident claim work with estate administration, commercial law and litigation, Booyens Law positions itself to handle a client's legal needs across more than one practice area rather than specialising narrowly in a single field. Based in Rietvalleirand, the firm serves clients across Pretoria seeking legal representation for accident claims, estate matters, commercial disputes or will drafting.

Branded Warehouse Erasmia is a clothing and accessories store on Helena Street in Erasmia, Centurion, offering a curated range of branded fashion at value-friendly prices. The store is set up for in-store shopping with card payment accepted, and it offers a wheelchair-accessible entrance together with wheelchair-accessible parking for customers with mobility needs. Its layout is organised to make it simple for shoppers to browse and find on-trend pieces without the store feeling cluttered, with staff available to assist customers through the buying process.

Branded Warehouse Erasmia trades Monday to Saturday, giving shoppers a consistent weekday and Saturday window to visit rather than limited weekend-only hours. Positioned within Erasmia, the store serves shoppers across Centurion looking for branded clothing at prices positioned below typical retail, combining an accessible, easy-to-browse shopping environment with a rotating stock of labelled fashion items. The emphasis on in-store service and straightforward card payment reflects a traditional bricks-and-mortar retail approach suited to shoppers who prefer to see and try on branded clothing in person before buying.

Capitec Bank's branch at Blu Valley Mall operates from Shop 41 on Bothrill Avenue in The Reeds, Centurion, forming part of the bank's retail branch network across the greater Pretoria area. The branch is categorised as a bank and financial institution, offering everyday banking services to shoppers and residents visiting Blu Valley Mall.

It keeps weekday hours from 9am to 6pm, Monday through Friday, with shorter Saturday hours from 8am to 1pm, giving customers a consistent window for in-branch banking around a typical working week and weekend mall visit. Being located inside Blu Valley Mall places the branch alongside other retail and dining outlets, which is convenient for customers combining a banking visit with other shopping in The Reeds. As one of several Capitec branches operating across the wider Centurion area, including locations in Centurion Central, Eldoraigne and Olievenhoutbosch, the Blu Valley Mall branch gives residents of The Reeds and surrounding suburbs a nearby option for standard retail banking without needing to travel into central Centurion.

Cappuccinos Southdowns is a branch of the Cappuccinos restaurant group, operating from Southdowns Shopping Centre at the corner of John Vorster Drive and Karee Street in Centurion. The Cappuccinos brand was founded in 1990 on an Italian-inspired concept brought to South Africa, and has since grown to eighteen stores across the country plus one in Botswana. The group describes its guiding idea as 'you are always welcome', aiming to give people from all walks of life the chance to enjoy hearty food served professionally.

Its menu is built around time-honoured family recipes combined with current food trends, prepared using what the group describes as the finest quality ingredients refined through ongoing trial and error. The brand's design approach uses food, texture and calming colour palettes to create a modern, uncluttered dining space that still feels warm and inviting rather than clinical. As one of the group's Centurion-area branches, Cappuccinos Southdowns gives shoppers at Southdowns Shopping Centre access to this same casual dining concept and menu, serving the Irene and Southdowns community alongside the brand's other Gauteng locations.

Carat Manufacturing Jewellers is a bespoke jewellery business based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, with more than 31 years of experience handcrafting pieces for customers across the region. The business specialises in transforming cherished heirlooms into updated, modern designs, working with customers to turn inherited stones and settings into pieces that still carry personal meaning. Alongside heirloom redesigns, Carat Manufacturing Jewellers creates bespoke pieces from scratch, including handcrafted engagement rings tailored to a couple's own style and story.

The business offers ethically sourced lab-grown diamonds as an alternative to mined stones, giving customers a lower-cost option that the business says looks just as brilliant as traditional diamonds. Its work is carried out by certified goldsmiths, reflecting a hands-on, workshop-based approach to jewellery making rather than selling only ready-made stock. Based in Garsfontein, the business describes its focus as combining craftsmanship with the emotional side of jewellery, aiming to carry a customer's own story through into a finished piece, whether that is an engagement ring, a wedding band or a reworked family heirloom.

Cashbuild Jubilee Mall is a hardware and building materials store operating from Shop 1 in Jubilee Mall on Harry Gwala Avenue, Hammanskraal, forming part of the national Cashbuild chain. The store stocks a broad range of building materials including cement, timber and roofing supplies, alongside hardware, plumbing, electrical and paint products, and garden supplies for both DIY customers and contractors. Cashbuild Jubilee Mall keeps extended trading hours, opening from 7am to 6pm on weekdays, 7am to 4pm on Saturdays and 8am to 2pm on Sundays, giving tradespeople and homeowners a wide window to collect materials around project schedules.

Among the amenities available at the store are free local delivery, in-store and online quotes, and facilities to buy SIM cards, airtime and data while shopping, alongside free parking for customers. The branch positions itself as a source of advice for contractors, DIYers and homeowners alike, rather than simply a shelf-stacked materials outlet. Based in Hammanskraal, Cashbuild Jubilee Mall serves local households and building trade customers with day-to-day and project-scale building material needs.

CH Building & Flyscreen is a Pretoria-based manufacturer of custom-made insect screens, operating from Wingate Park and producing made-to-measure window and door screens for homes across the city. Each screen is measured specifically for the opening it will cover, with the business aiming to minimise gaps between the screen and the frame so insects such as flies and mosquitoes are kept outside while fresh air and natural light continue to pass through. Alongside standard window and door screens, the business offers blockout solutions and two-in-one combinations that pair insect screening with a blockout layer in a single custom-fitted unit, as well as screens designed to hold up against pets. The company describes its purpose simply as letting doors and windows stay open while keeping insects outside, using fine mesh designed to preserve clear views rather than obstructing them.

By measuring each installation individually rather than supplying generic, off-the-shelf sizes, CH Building & Flyscreen aims to achieve a close, practical fit between the screen and the existing window or door. Based in Wingate Park, the business serves homeowners across Pretoria looking for a custom insect-screening solution.

CIVA Risk Management is a security solutions provider based in Zwartkop, Centurion, offering CCTV and fogging system installations for both homeowners and businesses. For homeowners, the company installs CCTV and indoor fog systems that it says can stop intruders quickly, without requiring long-term contracts or ongoing monthly fees. For business clients, CIVA focuses on reducing loss and strengthening control over premises, drawing on security approaches the company says have been used to protect some of South Africa's largest retail brands. CIVA describes itself as having more than twenty years of experience in the security industry, with teams operating nationwide across every province in South Africa.

The company imports security equipment in bulk, which it says allows it to offer premium-grade CCTV and fog systems at more accessible prices than buying through smaller, one-off suppliers. Its CCTV systems include remote access, letting clients monitor their property away from the premises itself. Based in Zwartkop, CIVA Risk Management brings this combination of CCTV, fog-system installation and nationwide security experience to both residential and commercial clients across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area.

CNET Consultancy is an IT consulting and technology support business based in Kilner Park, Pretoria, offering outsourced IT services backed by a round-the-clock call centre. The company's IT support service begins with an analysis of a client's needs before building a plan suited to that business, covering areas such as hardware support and data protection. CNET Consultancy also provides network managing services, with its consultants proposing strategic solutions intended to improve network uptime and align technology decisions with a client's broader goals. Voice over IP telephony forms a further part of its offering, giving clients an alternative to traditional fixed-line telephone systems.

The company positions its approach around addressing the underlying causes of IT problems rather than just the symptoms clients notice day to day, aiming to build fully automated support systems so clients can focus on running their business while CNET Consultancy manages the technology behind it. Each request is handled remotely where possible, with the company aiming to provide the same standard of professional assistance as an on-site technician. Based in Kilner Park, CNET Consultancy serves businesses across Pretoria needing outsourced IT support.

Cobus Visser International is a consulting firm based in Centurion Golf Estate, working across business upscaling, organisational cohesion and leadership empowerment through keynote talks, firewalking events and coaching programmes. The firm says its firewalking events alone have been part of a transformational experience for more than 13,000 people, while its keynote talks have reached audiences in the tens of thousands. Cobus Visser International describes its business-solutions work as contributing, directly and indirectly, to the creation and growth of around 8,000 jobs across a range of industries and countries.

Its client work spans both corporate organisations and start-ups, combining business-scaling support with leadership training intended to build cohesion within a company rather than focusing on individual performance alone. The firm has delivered keynote talks, firewalking events and training experiences not only across South Africa but also internationally, including in Sweden, Hungary, Mexico, Bali, the United States, Slovakia, the Czech Republic and New Zealand. Based in Centurion Golf Estate, Cobus Visser International positions itself as a consulting practice built around transformational, experience-led methods rather than conventional classroom-style business training alone.

Colbyn Electrical Services cc. is an electrical contracting business based in Colbyn, Pretoria, that has operated in the electrical industry since the 1980s. The company specialises in designing and installing electrical systems for the retail industry, with a particular focus on lighting effects for display windows, restaurants, shopping malls and office spaces, aiming to bring products and spaces to life through subtle, well-planned illumination. Its electricians are accredited to the SABS SANS 10142-1 standard, reflecting formal recognition as master electricians rather than general handymen. Colbyn Electrical Services keeps teams on standby to meet client needs around the clock, structuring its availability around client project schedules as well as emergencies and unplanned breakdowns. By combining retail lighting design work with round-the-clock availability for urgent electrical issues, the company positions itself to serve both planned installation projects and reactive emergency callouts from the same team.

Based in Colbyn, Colbyn Electrical Services treats electricity as an essential service, serving retail, hospitality and office clients across Pretoria who need both specialised lighting installation and responsive general electrical support.

ConnecTD Digital Solutions is a business outsourcing company based in Akasia, offering support services that let businesses hand off administrative and staffing-related tasks rather than handling them in-house. Its administration service covers day-to-day tasks aimed at keeping business operations running smoothly, while its HR offering focuses on pre-screening and recruitment to connect businesses with suitable candidates. ConnecTD Digital Solutions also provides profile designing services, helping individuals and businesses present their skills and experience more effectively, and it connects clients directly with freelancers for project-based work.

Beyond staffing and administration, the company offers broader business support services along with labour and hands-on task assistance, as well as marketing and digital services for clients wanting support with their online presence. The company describes its vision as empowering businesses and individuals through personalised services, extensive research and vetted freelancers, aiming to ensure successful, longer-term collaborations rather than one-off placements. Based in Akasia, ConnecTD Digital Solutions serves businesses across Pretoria's northern suburbs looking to outsource administration, recruitment, freelance staffing or digital marketing functions instead of building out these functions internally.
